selection: Per weighting, uniform sample of 12 completed growing tree or tree-plus starts or 28 growing census starts. Include all recorded parity misses, all 27 not-all-equal failures within t steps and all census stalls. Both laws on every selected start.
growth: Independent. The six-knot holdings are read from the earlier growth archives and the three successive census draws reselected from integer indices. Tree and tree-plus starts, loose counts, reader and all region draws are rebuilt from their weighting and seeds.
